title: Die For You
lyrics:
[00:15.27]Swear I couldn't sleep a wink last night
[00:18.51]No point in turning off the lights
[00:21.75]Not the same without your head on my shoulders
[00:24.96]Growing pains, but I don't wanna get older
[00:28.23]Almost like we left it all on read
[00:31.48]Couple feelings that were laid to rest
[00:34.76]Didn't know that the party was over
[00:38.00]And it's true that I need you here closer
[00:42.37]Burning photos
[00:45.58]Had to learn to let go
[00:48.51]I used to be
[00:55.07]Somebody in another skin (Another skin)
[00:59.86]I heard that you're happy without me
[01:04.70]And I hope it's true (I hope, I hope it's true)
[01:12.78]It kills me a little, that's okay
[01:17.65]'Cause I'd die for you
[01:22.88]You know I'd still die for you
[01:38.94]I hope you're getting everything you needed
[01:42.39]Found the puzzle piece and feel completed
[01:45.42]Just wanted you to know every reason
[01:48.85]Hope you really know that I mean that
[01:51.69]I couldn't see the forest from the trees
[01:57.84]Only time we speak is in my dreams
[02:06.68]Burning photos
[02:09.97]Had to learn to let go
[02:12.84]I used to be
[02:19.44]Somebody in another skin (Another skin)
[02:24.17]I heard that you're happy without me
[02:29.00]And I hope it's true (I hope, I hope it's true)
[02:37.14]It kills me a little, that's okay
[02:41.98]'Cause I'd die for you
[02:47.26]You know I'd still die for you
